query:
select model_column_id as "model_column_id!",
                  avg(ewma)::float8 as "availability!"
           from aggregates
           where model_column_id = any($1::text[])
             and capability = $2
             and difficulty_tier = $3
             and dimension = 'availability'
             and as_of >= $4
           group by model_column_id
           order by model_column_id
